locally verified drain, receptor, protection and permit requirements remove locations the hydraulics alone would have accepted
every stage added for protection has to fit inside the pressure the budget still has left at peak flow
a material condition discovered once the pipe is open, such as crumbling galvanized, must go through stop, document, explain and approve before the crew keeps cutting
the receptor's achievable rate and the permitted discharge destination limit which backwashing media configurations may be specified at all
the licensed scope of whoever is on site decides whether continuity restoration is performed in-house or referred to a qualified electrician
the vessel and valve that give the most attractive capacity and salt efficiency are frequently not the ones that pass peak flow within the available pressure
edges.resolution_rule: peak-flow pressure adequacy wins: if capacity and flow cannot both be satisfied, change vessel, valve or configuration and re-quote rather than install a train the budget says will starve the fixtures

edges.why_related: the only receptor that can be made acceptable is often nowhere near the tie-in the hydraulics and the customer both prefer
edges.resolution_rule: the cross-connection-safe waste connection dominates placement preference: relocate the equipment, extend the loop within the pressure budget, or build an approved receptor, and never shorten the drain by omitting the air gap

edges.why_related: the tightest position that satisfies the hydraulics and pleases the homeowner is often the one where no housing can be unscrewed and no tank lifted
edges.resolution_rule: serviceability wins over tidiness and over hydraulic elegance: move the equipment or change to a configuration that can be serviced in the available space, provided the revised layout still closes the pressure budget

edges.why_related: a subcontracted crew paid per job has its own incentive to enlarge or shorten scope at the customer's kitchen table, which is exactly what the scope-integrity rule forbids
edges.resolution_rule: scope-integrity rules bind every crew by written subcontract term: unapproved on-site scope changes are not billable and the business, not the subcontractor, delivers the change-order conversation and the handoff

edges.why_related: the pretreatment stages a well needs consume pressure and backwash water that the pump and pressure tank may not be able to give
edges.resolution_rule: pump capability caps the specification: choose a lower-backwash or cartridge configuration, or stage cycles into low-demand hours inside the pump's duty, rather than specifying a backwash the well cannot sustain

edges.why_related: where the equipment sits is the strongest single determinant of what an eventual failure costs, because the same weep is a nuisance over a floor drain and a claim over a finished ceiling
an unrelieved closed system raises pressure on every heating cycle, and that repeated stress is what turns sound joints and relief valves into callbacks
manufacturer coverage is commonly conditioned on operating within stated water-quality limits, so the recorded chemistry is what later determines whether a claim stands
what the survey finds decides which obligation classes actually need verifying, so the walk precedes the calls to the authority having jurisdiction
the walkthrough runs before the record is closed so anything the customer raises, declines or is promised is captured in the as-built rather than remembered
matched post-install readings and the regeneration intervals observed on installed accounts are the only real evidence that the sizing mechanism is calibrated for this service area
callback patterns by joint type and fitting batch are what retire a joining method from the standard rather than opinion about which method feels solid
recurring change orders and as-built surprises are the evidence that adds a field to the survey sheet so the next quote is not wrong the same way
both are sized by what the water experiences rather than by the size of the housing, and both fail the same way when feed conditions are assumed instead of measured

conflict_axes.name: capacity_and_efficiency_versus_peak_flow_pressure
conflict_axes.description: The vessel, valve and media volume that give the most attractive capacity, salt efficiency or contact time are often not the ones that pass the household's peak simultaneous flow inside the pressure the house actually has.
poles: size for capacity, efficiency and contact time
size for peak flow within the pressure budget
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: close the pressure budget first as a hard gate, then optimise capacity and efficiency inside what remains, and re-quote rather than accept a train the budget says will starve the fixtures

conflict_axes.name: ideal_hydraulic_position_versus_serviceable_position
conflict_axes.description: The shortest, tidiest tie-in that the customer likes to look at is frequently the position where no cartridge housing can be unscrewed, no media tank lifted and no brine tank filled without moving it.
poles: shortest and tidiest hydraulic position
position that a technician can service in two years
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat removal clearance and labelling as install requirements equal to hydraulics; relocate or reconfigure until both hold, and record the customer's agreement to the resulting location

conflict_axes.name: same_visit_close_versus_survey_first_discipline
conflict_axes.description: Quoting and installing on one visit wins deals against slower competitors, but it produces prices built on assumptions and change orders delivered to a customer standing over an open pipe.
poles: quote and install on the same visit
survey, verify and only then quote
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: allow a same-visit path only for job classes whose survey checklist can be completed in the same visit and whose obligation classes were already verified for that jurisdiction; otherwise quote from the survey record

conflict_axes.name: local_verification_time_versus_booking_the_job_today
conflict_axes.description: Verifying permit, discharge, protection and licensing classes with the authority takes calendar days that the customer experiences as hesitation, and occasionally returns an answer that ends the sale.
poles: verify every obligation class before selling
book now and resolve compliance during the install
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: maintain a per-jurisdiction verification file with dates so repeat classes are answered instantly, and hold the line that unverified obligations block the equipment order rather than the conversation

conflict_axes.name: in_house_crew_versus_subcontracted_licensed_plumber
conflict_axes.description: Fixed payroll and tooling buy scheduling control, one quality standard and ownership of the customer relationship, while per-job subcontracting buys flexibility and licensed coverage at the cost of workmanship variance and a third party standing in the doorway.
poles: carry an in-house install crew
subcontract to licensed plumbers per job
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: decide from booked install volume and the business's own loaded-cost and callback history rather than preference, and bind whichever model is chosen with a written standard covering scope discipline, warranty and customer ownership

conflict_axes.name: joint_speed_versus_reliability_and_serviceability
conflict_axes.description: Faster joining methods finish more installs per day, while the methods that are easiest to service or most tolerant of field conditions cost tooling money or minutes at every connection.
poles: fastest acceptable joining method
most reliable and most serviceable joint
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: let the callback record decide the standard method per material class, and never let schedule pressure substitute a faster method on a joint that the standard has already ruled out

conflict_axes.name: protective_stages_versus_pressure_and_leak_points
conflict_axes.description: Every protective stage extends the life of what sits behind it, and every one of them also consumes pressure, adds joints that can weep and adds components a technician must service.
poles: add protective stages
keep the train short
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: add a stage only where it demonstrably converts an expensive replacement into a cheap one, and only while the pressure budget still closes with fouling headroom

conflict_axes.name: field_reading_speed_versus_laboratory_certainty
conflict_axes.description: A same-day field reading keeps the job moving, while an accredited-lab result is the only defensible basis for parameters that decide expensive hardware or that the customer is anxious about.
poles: size from the field reading now
wait for the accredited-lab result
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: size from field readings only where the parameter is robust to the method's error band, and escalate to a laboratory whenever the parameter drives an irreversible or costly design choice or a specific-contaminant concern

conflict_axes.name: provable_performance_versus_persuasive_overclaim
conflict_axes.description: The install is easiest to celebrate with sweeping statements about pure or safe water, and the only defensible statement is a measured change in the parameters the system was actually sold to change.
poles: say what makes the customer happiest
say only what the matched readings support
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state performance as the before-and-after on named parameters, name explicitly what the system does not address, and make no health claim under any circumstances

conflict_axes.name: well_pump_protection_versus_treatment_completeness
conflict_axes.description: A well often needs oxidation, filtration and softening in series to reach the water the customer wants, while the pump and pressure tank set a hard ceiling on how much backwash and pressure loss the system can absorb.
poles: treat everything the well presents
stay inside what the pump and tank can sustain
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: cap the specification at the pump's demonstrated capability, stage cycles into low-demand hours, and where the water still needs more, price the pump-side work as a separate referred scope rather than overloading the existing system

edge_cases.description: The only receptor that can be made cross-connection safe is across the garage from the tie-in the hydraulics wanted
edge_cases.trigger: no acceptable drain arrangement exists within reach of the preferred equipment position
edge_cases.mitigation: move the equipment to the receptor and re-run the pressure budget for the longer run, or build an approved receptor at the equipment; never close the gap by omitting the air gap or taping a hose into a standpipe

edge_cases.description: Cutting into the service line reveals galvanized pipe that crumbles at the tie-in
edge_cases.trigger: aged pipe disintegrates when disturbed and the clean tie-in becomes a repair of unknown extent
edge_cases.mitigation: stop, photograph, present the repair option and the deferral option in writing with what each means, obtain recorded approval, and leave the house with water restored even if the customer defers the treatment install entirely

edge_cases.description: The relief valve at the water heater begins discharging days after the new equipment goes in
edge_cases.trigger: the house was already a closed system, or the install created one, and no expansion provision exists
edge_cases.mitigation: check the closed-system question at survey; if it surfaces afterwards, disclose immediately, correct inside the licensed scope or refer in writing, and never describe the discharge to the customer as normal operation

edge_cases.description: The customer insists the equipment go in a finished carpeted room, or downstream of the water heater where the pipe is easiest to reach
edge_cases.trigger: the homeowner's preferred location conflicts with hot-side coverage or with leak-consequence-aware siting
edge_cases.mitigation: explain the hot-side and water-damage consequences in writing, offer a pan, sensor or shutoff plus alternative positions, and decline in writing any placement that cannot be made safe rather than installing under protest

edge_cases.description: The well pump cannot deliver the backwash rate the selected media needs
edge_cases.trigger: the backwash draw calculated for the bed exceeds what the pump and pressure tank sustain
edge_cases.mitigation: select a lower-backwash or cartridge configuration, or stage the cycle into low-demand hours inside the pump's duty, and refer pump-side work to the well contractor rather than specifying a rate the well cannot supply

edge_cases.description: The post-install treated-tap reading does not show the change the design predicted
edge_cases.trigger: commissioning verification fails against the pre-install baseline
edge_cases.mitigation: check bypass position, programmed settings and the sample point before touching the design, then re-verify the chemistry inputs and the sizing, and do not hand the system over as proven until the discrepancy is explained

edge_cases.description: The local authority restricts discharging regeneration brine to the customer's septic system
edge_cases.trigger: verification of the discharge destination returns a restriction after the treatment class has already been discussed
edge_cases.mitigation: verify discharge before the sale closes; where a restriction applies, present configurations that change or reduce discharge, or decline the job honestly, and never install on the assumption that nobody will look

edge_cases.description: The incoming metallic pipe turns out to be part of the building's grounding arrangement and the install interrupts it
edge_cases.trigger: equipment or a plastic bypass assembly breaks continuity in a bonded metallic service line
edge_cases.mitigation: restore continuity as the locally verified requirement class prescribes, or stop and bring in a qualified electrician in writing before the job is closed out, and record which was done

edge_cases.description: An elderly customer is alone at handoff and is visibly not following the orientation
edge_cases.trigger: the person receiving the walkthrough cannot absorb the bypass and maintenance instructions
edge_cases.mitigation: offer to pause and return with a family member or trusted contact present, leave written instructions with the bypass photographed and labelled, and make no additional sale or change order during that visit

edge_cases.description: The counter or sink deck cannot take the reverse-osmosis faucet the customer selected
edge_cases.trigger: stone, an obstructed cabinet or no spare deck hole is discovered at the moment of drilling
edge_cases.mitigation: stop before any hole is made, present the alternatives including different mount points and arrangements verified as acceptable locally, and obtain written approval of the exact position before drilling anything irreversible

edge_cases.description: A subcontracted plumber leaves a personal card and offers to handle future filter changes directly
edge_cases.trigger: the third party installing the system moves to own the recurring relationship
edge_cases.mitigation: write customer ownership, warranty routing and non-solicitation into the subcontract terms, and have the business rather than the subcontractor deliver the orientation and hand over the record

workflow.action: Walk the house and issue a feasibility verdict
workflow.description: Record tie-in, pipe material and size, static and flowing pressure, drain, receptacle, clearance, carry path, freeze exposure and the condition of existing plumbing
workflow.artifact: signed site-survey record with feasibility verdict
workflow.gate: every survey field is populated and the verdict is issued before any quote is produced

workflow.action: Convert the verified test results into sizing loads
workflow.description: Translate hardness, iron, disinfectant class, pH and sediment into engineering load parameters and list what still needs a defensible reading
workflow.artifact: sizing input sheet with parameter sources
workflow.gate: every parameter traces to a dated test or the utility report, and open items are listed before hardware is specified

workflow.description: Separate daily volume from peak simultaneous flow, reconcile against billing or meter data where available, and record announced changes
workflow.gate: daily volume basis, peak flow basis, the source of each and any upcoming change are all stated

workflow.action: Verify the obligation classes with the authority having jurisdiction
workflow.description: Check permit and inspection, adopted code and amendments, cross-connection protection, discharge destination, electrical and licensing classes for this job
workflow.gate: each class carries the authority or document consulted, the date and the disposition, and no unverified specific appears in customer material

workflow.action: Size each treatment stage from load and flow
workflow.description: Compute the grain load and any iron compensation, choose the salt-efficiency point deliberately, set the reserve, and check service flow against the profile
workflow.gate: the sizing basis, reserve, expected regeneration interval and service-flow check are all recorded with their inputs

workflow.action: Close the flow and pressure budget
workflow.description: Subtract each stage's loss at peak flow from the measured baseline using manufacturer curves and keep fouling headroom
workflow.gate: the remaining pressure exceeds what the house's fixtures need at peak flow with headroom left for fouling

workflow.action: Sequence the train and place prefiltration
workflow.description: Order the stages so each protects the next, put the sacrificial consumable where the load falls, and step the micron rating down rather than jumping
workflow.gate: each stage has a stated protective reason and the accumulated loss stays inside the pressure budget

workflow.action: Fix placement, bypass, drain, power and service clearance together
workflow.description: Settle the tie-in position, the loop geometry, the isolation and bypass, the waste connection, the receptacle and the clearance a technician will need, and get the customer's agreement
workflow.artifact: install plan with placement drawing and customer agreement
workflow.gate: placement satisfies tie-in order, waste connection, power, freeze protection, load bearing, leak consequence and service clearance, and the customer has agreed in the record

workflow.action: Execute the connections under the scope-integrity rule
workflow.description: Use transitions accepted for the materials found, respect plastic torque and sealant instructions, support vessel weight, and stop for written approval on anything the survey did not cover
workflow.gate: no joint departs from the material standard and every discovered condition has a photographed, approved change order behind it

workflow.action: Pressure test and run a full cycle
workflow.description: Hold pressure and inspect every joint under it, then run a full regeneration or backwash cycle while watching the drain
workflow.gate: pressure held for the standard period with no weep and a complete cycle observed by the crew before departure

workflow.action: Commission and verify against the pre-install reading
workflow.description: Purge and sanitize, program from verified inputs, set the regeneration hour to the household's quiet time, check flow and pressure, and take the matched post-install sample
workflow.gate: settings trace to verified inputs and the matched pre and post readings show the change on the parameters that were sold, with no claim beyond them

workflow.action: Orient the homeowner and close the record
workflow.description: Demonstrate the bypass, explain the consumable mechanism and the sensory changes, state plainly what the system does not do, and hand over the as-built and warranty boundary
workflow.artifact: signed handoff pack and completed as-built record
workflow.gate: the customer has operated the bypass, the not-covered statement was made, and the record holds settings, serials, photographs, verifications and approved change orders

dominance_rules.rule: A locally verified requirement dominates both design preference and customer preference
dominance_rules.rationale: an install that violates an obligation class can be ordered out, refused at inspection or discovered at resale, and no elegance or convenience survives that
dominance_rules.trigger: a verified permit, waste-connection, protection, discharge, bonding or licensing requirement conflicts with the preferred layout or with what the customer is asking for
dominance_rules.action: build to the verified requirement or decline the work, and write the decision and its basis into the job record

dominance_rules.rule: Cross-connection protection dominates the convenience of the drain run
dominance_rules.rationale: backflow of regeneration or concentrate waste into the potable system is the one failure that reaches beyond the customer to everyone downstream of them
dominance_rules.trigger: the acceptable air gap or receptor is inconvenient, distant, or unattractive to the customer
dominance_rules.action: keep the air gap or approved receptor and move the equipment, extend the loop within the pressure budget, or build a compliant receptor

dominance_rules.rule: Dated test data dominates field impressions, demonstrations and regional habit in every sizing decision
dominance_rules.rationale: hardware sized on an assumption is wrong in a way nobody discovers until the customer complains, and a demonstration proves nothing about a measured parameter
dominance_rules.trigger: a sizing input has no dated reading behind it, or a field reading is contradicted by the utility report or by a laboratory result
dominance_rules.action: obtain a defensible reading, escalating to an accredited laboratory where the parameter drives an expensive or irreversible choice, before hardware is ordered

dominance_rules.rule: Peak-flow pressure adequacy dominates capacity ambition and stage count
dominance_rules.rationale: a household notices a weak shower every single day, while it notices an extra regeneration only on the salt bill
dominance_rules.trigger: the pressure budget does not close with fouling headroom at the profile's peak flow
dominance_rules.action: enlarge the vessel or valve, remove or reconfigure a stage, or re-quote; never install a train the budget says will fail

dominance_rules.rationale: one water-damage claim can exceed the margin on many installs and follows the business through reviews and insurance history
dominance_rules.trigger: the crew is behind and the pressure hold or the full cycle has not been completed
dominance_rules.action: treat the job as unfinished: stay and complete the test and cycle, or return before the customer relies on the system unattended

dominance_rules.rule: Written approval dominates verbal agreement for any change in scope
dominance_rules.rationale: a change agreed over an open pipe cannot be reconstructed by either party a month later, and the customer is the one at a disadvantage
dominance_rules.trigger: a condition is discovered after work has started, or the customer asks for something outside the quoted scope
dominance_rules.action: stop, photograph the condition, explain the cost and the option to defer, and record the customer's approval before resuming

dominance_rules.rule: Customer comprehension dominates visit efficiency, and vulnerable-customer pacing dominates closing anything
dominance_rules.rationale: an install the customer does not understand generates support calls, distrust and regret, and pressure applied to someone who cannot follow is not a sale but a harm
dominance_rules.trigger: the customer is not following the explanation, or is elderly, alone, unwell or visibly overwhelmed
dominance_rules.action: slow down, offer a second pass, a family member or trusted contact, or a return visit, and close no change order or additional sale in that state

dominance_rules.rule: Serviceability dominates hydraulic elegance when both cannot be had
dominance_rules.rationale: the recurring revenue and the customer's long-term satisfaction are collected by a technician who has to physically reach the equipment
dominance_rules.trigger: the chosen position cannot give removal clearance for a housing, a media tank or a brine lid
dominance_rules.action: relocate or reconfigure to a serviceable arrangement that still closes the pressure budget, and label the stages before leaving

dominance_rules.rule: Manufacturer instructions dominate installer habit wherever coverage depends on them
dominance_rules.rationale: warranty coverage is commonly conditioned on installation and startup performed as the manufacturer specifies, and habit is not a defence when a claim is refused
dominance_rules.trigger: standard crew practice differs from the manufacturer's stated installation, torque, sanitizing or startup requirement
dominance_rules.action: follow the manufacturer's instruction, or record the deviation with its warranty consequence and disclose that consequence to the customer in writing

dominance_rules.rule: Provable parameter change dominates persuasive language, and no health claim is ever permitted
dominance_rules.rationale: the business's licence to operate honestly rests on saying only what measurement supports, and health claims are outside the competence and the lawful scope of a treatment installer
dominance_rules.trigger: a crew member, a subcontractor or a customer frames the result as safety, purity or a health benefit
dominance_rules.action: restate the outcome as the measured before-and-after on named parameters, name what the system does not address, and correct the record and any material that overstates it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Survey the house and quote from the survey record, never from a phone description or a photograph
anti_rework_rules.prevents: install-day change orders, the wrong equipment on the truck, and a price argument the customer is entitled to win

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the obligation classes with the authority before equipment is ordered or the sale is closed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an installation that has to be moved, reconfigured or removed after an inspection or a discharge restriction surfaces

anti_rework_rules.rule: Convert chemistry into load parameters before any hardware is selected
anti_rework_rules.prevents: returning to swap a vessel or add a stage after a retest shows the design was sized for water this house does not have

anti_rework_rules.rule: Close the pressure budget before the layout is drawn and before the stage count is agreed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a fully installed train that must be reconfigured because the upstairs shower failed the moment two fixtures ran

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the receptor, its rate and its permitted destination before selecting a backwashing configuration
anti_rework_rules.prevents: swapping a backwashing tank for a cartridge configuration, or relocating the whole train, after the equipment is already set

anti_rework_rules.rule: Sequence the train before fixing placement, and fix placement before cutting anything
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-plumbing a finished loop because a protective stage has to be inserted ahead of a vessel that is already tied in

anti_rework_rules.rule: Design bypass, isolation, drain-down and service clearance in the same act as placement
anti_rework_rules.prevents: cutting pipe on the first service call and relocating equipment that was installed where nobody can work on it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Ask the closed-system, expansion and bonding questions at survey rather than at commissioning
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a post-install relief-valve discharge or grounding discovery that the customer reasonably blames on the new equipment

anti_rework_rules.rule: Pressure test and run a full cycle before the crew leaves, not after the first customer report
anti_rework_rules.prevents: water damage remediation, an emergency callback, and a dispute that costs more than the install earned

anti_rework_rules.rule: Photograph joints and record settings, serials and verifications as the work happens
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reconstructing an as-built from memory, losing a warranty claim on an unevidenced condition, and pricing the service plan blind

iteration_protocol.trigger: the matched post-install reading does not show the change the design predicted
iteration_protocol.action: check bypass position, programmed settings and sample point first, then re-verify the chemistry inputs and the sizing basis before altering the design, and hold the handoff until it is explained
pull the joint photographs and the test record, root-cause the method and the fitting class rather than only the individual joint, and change the install standard before the next job goes out

iteration_protocol.trigger: the customer reports pressure loss after the install
iteration_protocol.action: re-measure at the fixtures, re-run the budget with a fouled-media allowance, and service or reconfigure the offending stage rather than telling the customer this is normal

iteration_protocol.trigger: the business begins selling in a new jurisdiction or a code cycle is adopted or amended locally
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify every obligation class with the new authority, refresh the verification file with dates, and update the labor and licensing decision before quoting anything there

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same discovered condition produces change orders across several jobs
iteration_protocol.action: add the condition to the survey checklist, retrain the surveyors on how to detect it, and review whether the affected quotes were fair

iteration_protocol.trigger: service visits run long or technicians report that they cannot reach components
iteration_protocol.action: audit recent placements against the clearance and labelling standard and revise the standard and the install plan template

iteration_protocol.trigger: the utility changes disinfectant practice or a retest shows the source chemistry has moved
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the load parameters and check whether the installed media class and sizing still hold for the affected accounts, then plan the corrective visits

iteration_protocol.trigger: a subcontracted crew produces a callback, a complaint, or an attempt to take over the customer relationship
iteration_protocol.action: review the subcontract terms on scope discipline, warranty and customer ownership, re-inspect a sample of that crew's recent installs, and re-run the in-house versus subcontract comparison on current volume

priority_rationale: The frame units come first because nothing downstream is decidable without them: the survey establishes what this house physically permits, the verified chemistry and the demand profile supply the two load inputs every sizing mechanism consumes, the obligation classes must be verified with the authority before anything is sold or ordered, the labor and licensing model decides who may lawfully do the work, and the scope-integrity rule governs how every later discovery is handled; the sizing units then convert loads into hardware and are gated by the flow and pressure budget; sequencing and placement turn sized components into a physical layout that the waste connection, cross-connection, expansion, bonding and service-clearance units constrain; execution units make and prove the joints, because leak control is the risk that dominates the trade; and commissioning, orientation and the as-built record come last because they convert a finished assembly into proven performance, an informed homeowner, and the handoff artifact the recurring service relationship depends on.
